name: Tommy Jackett
jobTitle: Video producer, storyteller and podcast host
entityStatement: Tommy Jackett is a Melbourne video producer, storyteller and podcast host. He is featured in and co-hosts the 2026 documentary In Guns We Trust, directed by Josh Janssen, and makes video and podcasts for businesses and creators through VIDPOD.
entityStatementShort: Tommy Jackett is a Melbourne video producer and storyteller, featured in the documentary In Guns We Trust (2026).

film.title: In Guns We Trust

whenShort.before: Free on YouTube, worldwide. Thursday 22 October, 8pm ET. That's Friday 23 October, 11am in Melbourne (AEDT).
whenShort.after: Free on YouTube, worldwide, since Thursday 22 October 8pm ET (Friday 23 October, 11am AEDT).

whenFull.before: In Guns We Trust is free on YouTube, worldwide, from Thursday 22 October 2026 at 8pm US Eastern, which is Friday 23 October at 11am in Melbourne (AEDT).
whenFull.after: In Guns We Trust is free on YouTube, worldwide, since Thursday 22 October 2026 at 8pm US Eastern, which was Friday 23 October at 11am in Melbourne (AEDT).

film.contentNote: Includes gunfire and discussion of shootings, suicide and loss. Made for adults and older teenagers watching with support.
film.support: Support: in the US call or text 988. In Australia call Lifeline on 13 11 14. Elsewhere, findahelpline.com.
film.supportInline: If you need someone to talk to: US 988, Australia Lifeline 13 11 14, findahelpline.com.
film.timeNote: ET means US Eastern. AEDT means Melbourne time.
film.creditLine: In Guns We Trust is made by 2A Film, Full Stack Films and Rethink Films. Film images are stills from In Guns We Trust (2026), directed by Josh Janssen. © 2026 2A Film Pty Ltd.
film.oneLiner: A 2026 documentary by Josh Janssen: two unarmed Australians listen to gun owners, survivors and sheriffs across America.

home.title: Tommy Jackett: video producer and storyteller
home.description: Hey, I'm Tommy Jackett. I make video and podcasts in Melbourne, and I'm in the documentary In Guns We Trust, free on YouTube 23 Oct 2026.
